scripts.dev: node scripts/free-ports.mjs api web && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @storytime/server" "npm run dev -w @storytime/web"
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/free-ports.mjs api && npm run dev -w @storytime/server
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/free-ports.mjs web && npm run dev -w @storytime/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @storytime/shared && npm run build -w @storytime/web && npm run build -w @storytime/server
scripts.start: node scripts/free-ports.mjs api web && npm run start -w @storytime/server
